lines.t: In the shadow, I found the flame Calling out your holy name
Breaking chains, I'm rising high Spirit soaring through the sky
They look at the surface, they see the disguise
But I see the heart through the fire in my eyes
Just on the rock, no, I'm never on sand
I'm holding the flame in the palm of his hand
Glory to glory, we're leveling up
The mercy is low and it's filling my cup
Yeah, I'm focused on him, no, I never can stop
With the grace and the power, I'm straight to the top
